title: Hugging Face adds FLUX.3 Image Klein models to Diffusers
excerpt: The integration includes a distilled checkpoint for fast inference and a base model for fine-tuning.
bodyHtml:
Hugging Face announced on October 15, 2026, that the FLUX.3 Image Klein collection from Black Forest Labs is available in Diffusers. The collection includes two open checkpoints: a distilled model for fast inference and a base model intended for fine-tuning.

The distilled checkpoint generates a 1024 × 1024 image in about 2 seconds on an H100. This model runs in 16 steps with no CFG. The base model runs in 50 steps with CFG. Both models ship as a Modular Diffusers pipeline, allowing users to pop blocks out or add their own.

The architecture uses Qwen3-VL as a text encoder. The system supports LoRA training scripts for both text-to-image and image editing. Users can load quantized variants, including fp8r and nvfp4, using from_single_file. The distilled checkpoint generates a 1024 × 1024 image in 16 steps by default, though users can pass height, width, or num_inference_steps to change these parameters.
